list.title: Occasions
list.emptyBody: Start with a title and a date. Begin from a template with prepared tasks, or from a blank page.

date.byPoll: Date to be decided by poll
date.pollHint: You can create the occasion without a date. Template tasks get their due dates once you set it.

new.title: New occasion
new.description: A title, a template and a date are enough to begin. Everything else can change later.

templateNote.one: {description} {count} prepared task, scheduled around the date.
templateNote.few: {description} {count} prepared tasks, scheduled around the date.
templateNote.other: {description} {count} prepared tasks, scheduled around the date.

new.templateBlank: No prepared tasks: you add your own.

brief.title: In brief
brief.intro: Why the occasion is happening and what matters most. Tasks can be linked to these priorities.
brief.purposeHint: A sentence or two that everyone on the team will understand.

deletion.bannerTitle: This occasion is going to be deleted
deletion.bannerBody: Until {date} you can restore it with everything in it. After that it is deleted for good.
deletion.title: Deleting the occasion
deletion.pendingHere: The deletion is scheduled. You can cancel it until {date}, from the band at the top of the page.
deletion.intro: After you ask for deletion you have {days} days to cancel it. During that time the team still sees the occasion, with a notice. Then its tasks, team, guests and files are deleted for good.
deletion.retainedIntro: The law requires us to keep a few things even after deletion:
deletion.retainedReceipts: receipts and payment documents — {years} years, for accounting;
deletion.retainedObjections: objection and removal requests — {years} years, so we can keep honouring them;
deletion.retainedAudit: the log of sensitive actions — {years} years, for security.
deletion.freshBody: Deleting an occasion needs a fresh confirmation. You can do it here or from your account page.
deletion.confirmBody: “{title}” will be deleted in {days} days. Until then you can restore it at any time.

cancelled.title: This occasion was cancelled
cancelled.body: The plan stays here for reference.

postponed.title: This occasion was postponed
postponed.body: When you set the new date, task due dates move with it.

closed.title: This occasion is over
closed.body: The plan stays here for reference.

proposals.title: What if?
proposals.description: Important changes appear here first, with everything they would alter. Nothing is applied until someone confirms.
proposals.emptyBody: When you move the date or re-run a template, the preview appears here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The occasion's details, its date, and deletion.
settings.readOnlyBody: Only the owner and project managers can change the occasion's details.

move.title: Occasion date
move.intro: Choose the new date and see what changes first: every task whose due date moves is listed in a preview. Nothing is applied until you confirm.

errors.dateRequired: Choose the date, or switch to “We'll decide by poll”.
errors.endBeforeStart: The last day cannot be before the first day.
errors.sameDate: That is already the occasion's date. Choose a different one.

whatif.moreTasks: and {count} more tasks change their due date
